title: Compiler setting construction
statement: Let $W$ be a word size, let the resource limits, program $P$, designated procedure index, and Boolean flag be fixed, and suppose the word size fits the limits, dispatcher position, and stack-cell count required by the compiler. The compiler setting for these data consists of the program layout and compiled code, with each procedure body followed by its return sequence before the dispatcher, the dispatcher at its specified position, and every procedure body of width at most the frame size.
hypotheses_covered: The word size satisfies the compiler's fit conditions for the limits, dispatcher position, and stack-cell count
